name: Phone verify runner (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: the verify queue's runner (tools/phone/verify/queue.sh run, from the .claude/worktrees/verify-runner checkout) as the launchd agent com.powos.verify-runner: started when a job lands in ~/.cache/powos-verify-queue (WatchPaths, no polling) and again if it dies (KeepAlive), so queued phone checks never stall on a stopped process. A user stop from the phone is a pause inside it (resume on the AI page). Exits by itself when nothing is queued
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one bash loop that mostly waits on one held adb call, its checks' own processes while a window runs
